purpose: Single source of truth for every tracked repository path owner, permitted contents, dependency direction, accountable change and integration roles, and shared-surface policy.

owners.changeOwner: Repository owner or delegated maintainer for archival/root-reference files
allowedContents: Historical DEPLOY and TRIGGER-DEPLOY text records
Legacy root index.html snapshot; not a Worker-served asset
owners.dependencyDirection: No runtime imports. These paths are archival/reference material and must not become runtime or build inputs without an explicit ownership transfer.
owners.sharedSurfacePolicy: Archive-only. New active application source, deployment configuration, and build inputs must live under their dedicated owned roots. Changes to legal notices require repository-owner review.

owners.dependencyDirection: Build orchestration invokes registered engineering tooling; production runtime must never import scripts or package-management configuration.
owners.sharedSurfacePolicy: Dependency changes require lockfile consistency, supply-chain review, and the full Cloudflare build/readiness gate.

allowedContents: wrangler.toml Worker entrypoint, D1 binding, asset binding, compatibility and environment configuration
owners.dependencyDirection: Deployment configuration points to the Worker runtime, public asset root, and D1 schema contract; it does not import application source.
owners.sharedSurfacePolicy: No credentials or secrets in tracked config. Production bindings and migrations require explicit environment review; deployment is a separate release action.

allowedContents: GitHub Actions workflow definitions and repository automation configuration
owners.dependencyDirection: Workflows invoke registered build and engineering commands; application runtime must not depend on GitHub workflow files.
owners.sharedSurfacePolicy: Use least-privilege permissions, deterministic triggers, and required validation gates. Workflow changes must not bypass governance, migration, route, or Cloudflare checks.

owners.dependencyDirection: Design source is upstream of frontend implementation; runtime components must consume approved/generated assets rather than importing governance documents.
owners.sharedSurfacePolicy: Token and component changes require contrast, accessibility, responsive, and RTL review before frontend integration.

allowedContents: Product, operations, legal, competitive, media, release and source-recovery reference documents
owners.dependencyDirection: Documentation may describe implementation but must not be imported by production runtime or build scripts as executable policy.
owners.sharedSurfacePolicy: Keep evidence dates and implementation status explicit; do not describe planned or historical features as live.

owners.dependencyDirection: Architecture contracts describe and validate runtime boundaries; runtime code must not import documentation files. Tests may read these contracts.
owners.sharedSurfacePolicy: Changes to canonical registries or shared contracts require an ADR and matching executable validation in the same PR.

allowedContents: Engineering policy, ownership, migration and release governance documentation
owners.dependencyDirection: Policy documentation is enforced by tooling; runtime modules must not import governance documents.
owners.sharedSurfacePolicy: Policy changes require an explicit owner, enforceable validation, and migration path for existing repositories.

allowedContents: Indexes, constraints, schema evolution and data backfills
owners.dependencyDirection: Worker runtime consumes the schema through SQL and D1 bindings; migrations must not import application code or frontend assets.
owners.sharedSurfacePolicy: Forward-only migrations, explicit rollback/recovery strategy, migration governance and no production D1 mutation during architecture-foundation work.

allowedContents: CSS, fonts, icons and public media assets
owners.dependencyDirection: Browser code communicates with Worker APIs through documented HTTP contracts; it must not import Worker internals, D1 migrations, scripts, or secrets.
owners.sharedSurfacePolicy: No server secrets or direct database access. Source and served/versioned bundles must remain synchronized; accessibility, responsive and RTL checks are required.

owners.dependencyDirection: Tooling may import the runtime modules it validates; production Worker and browser code must never import scripts.
owners.sharedSurfacePolicy: Tests must be deterministic and fail closed on missing evidence. Tooling must not perform production deployment or D1 mutation unless a separately authorized release workflow invokes it.

owners.changeOwner: Worker API, security and runtime maintainer
owners.dependencyDirection: Worker modules import only other Worker modules. D1 schema and public assets are runtime bindings/contracts, not static code imports. Worker code must not import scripts, docs, workflows, or browser bundles.
owners.sharedSurfacePolicy: All user-owned data requires session and object-level ownership checks; rights/publishing gates must be enforced server-side; secrets remain in environment bindings.

owners.changeOwner: Production D1 audit, backup, restore and release evidence maintainer
allowedContents: Canonical migration risk and release plans
Backup, restore, rehearsal and release evidence records
owners.dependencyDirection: Operational documentation describes controlled procedures; runtime code must not import production documentation and documentation must not authorize unreviewed production mutations.
owners.sharedSurfacePolicy: Documentation is evidence and guidance only. Production D1 mutation, migration execution, secret changes and Worker deployment require separate explicit release authorization.

sharedSurfaceRule: Every changed path must match exactly one owner. Paths whose owner requiresAdr=true require an ADR under docs/architecture/decisions/ or a feature contract under docs/architecture/feature-contracts/ in the same PR. Every tracked path is also checked for exactly one owner so unregistered baseline files cannot hide until changed.

dependencyPolicy.staticImportRule: Same-owner imports are allowed. Cross-owner relative imports are allowed only when the source owner's allowedDependencies lists the target owner.
dependencyPolicy.runtimeContractRule: HTTP API, D1 schema, asset binding, design token and CI invocation relationships are declared separately as runtimeContracts/invokes and are not static import permissions.
dependencyPolicy.unresolvedRelativeImportRule: Every relative static/dynamic import must resolve to a tracked file or the governance gate fails.
dependencyPolicy.noReverseDependencies: Frontend, Worker, migrations, docs, and scripts may not import from a lower-level or unrelated domain unless explicitly allowed.

registryName: Imperial Novel canonical root-path ownership registry
